messages:
maria: Quick sync after the weekend incidents. Multiple upstream layers are adding role claims; our blind unioning produced accidental org-level grants. Need a deterministic precedence.
jonathan: Repro: client -> edge-proxy -> ingress -> operator-sidecar -> service. Each layer may stamp roles. Current mapper unions everything.
li: Unioning is risky. I propose deny-overrides for conflicting high-priv roles, then a weighted precedence for permits.
alex: Agreed. Suggested trust weights: service=100, operator=80, ingress=50, edge=40, client=10. Choose claim with max(weight + specificity).
maria: Specificity tiebreaker: project id = 2, wildcard = 1. Also require provenance: {role, scope, source, stamp_id}. If stamp_id missing -> treat low trust.
patrick: Ops requests: emit mapping_decisions_total, conflict_denied_total, sampled_conflict_payloads (0.1%), and mapping_latency_ms.
jonathan: Pseudo logic: group by (role,scope). If any claim has deny=true -> deny. Else pick claim with highest (trust_weight + specificity). Cap untrusted claims at 20 weight.
li: Edge-case: client sends specific project while operator gives wildcard. We must not let client escalate. Cap fixes that.
alex: Hard cap claims per request (e.g., 250). If exceeded, trim lowest-trust claims or fail-closed based on route flag.
maria: Migration plan: week0 shadow logging (no enforcement), week1 FF canary 5%, week2 25% + chaos, week3 rollout with enhanced audit retention. Gating: <0.05% delta in 4xx/5xx and conflict_denied_total within expected.
jonathan: I'll open the mapping-service PR with shadow mode behind FF.
patrick: I'll add Grafana panels and an alert for spikes in conflict_denied_total.
li: I'll add unit/integration tests and the fuzz harness for claim arrays.
infra-bot: Ingress proxy schema change to include stamp_id is queued for next sprint.
sec-bot: Created GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/517 titled "claims-combining-algo-deny-overrides-and-provenance-envelope" and attached traces.
maria: Drop any incident repros into that issue and label with incident-402. We'll reconvene after the shadow week to review metrics.
